usedFor: AltTextLab writes image descriptions for accessibility, and “Generate Alt Text” can run on each image your team publishes.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new post is published on a company page” in LinkedIn, then “Generate Alt Text” in AltTextLab
bestTemplate.why: Each published company post gets alt text without anyone writing it by hand.

watchOut: Alt text from “Generate Alt Text” is machine written, so have someone read it before it reaches a public page.
